diff --git a/src/audit/summary.py b/src/audit/summary.py
index 4a5f623..88f8522 100644
--- a/src/audit/summary.py
+++ b/src/audit/summary.py
@@ -1,3 +1,51 @@
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+
+_TIMESTAMP_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z")
+
 def legacy_summary(events):
     """Existing summary counts every input event, including duplicates."""
     return {"total": len(events)}
+
+def _valid_timestamp(value):
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or _TIMESTAMP_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) is None:
+        return False
+    try:
+        datetime(int(value[0:4]), int(value[5:7]), int(value[8:10]),
+                 int(value[11:13]), int(value[14:16]), int(value[17:19]))
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+    return True
+
+def _event_error(event):
+    """Return the first invalid field reason for an event, or None."""
+    event_id = event.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(event_id, str) or event_id == "":
+        return "invalid_id"
+    kind = event.get("kind")
+    if not isinstance(kind, str) or kind == "":
+        return "invalid_kind"
+    if not _valid_timestamp(event.get("timestamp")):
+        return "invalid_timestamp"
+    return None
+
+def event_snapshot(events, start=None, end=None):
+    """Count first valid in-window events per id; the fixed-width format orders as text."""
+    counts = {}
+    accepted_ids = []
+    errors = []
+    seen_ids = set()
+    for index, event in enumerate(events):
+        reason = _event_error(event)
+        if reason is not None:
+            errors.append({"index": index, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+        timestamp = event["timestamp"]
+        if (start is not None and timestamp < start) or (end is not None and timestamp > end):
+            continue
+        if event["id"] in seen_ids:
+            continue
+        seen_ids.add(event["id"])
+        accepted_ids.append(event["id"])
+        counts[event["kind"]] = counts.get(event["kind"], 0) + 1
+    return {"counts": counts, "accepted_ids": accepted_ids, "errors": errors}
diff --git a/src/catalog/query.py b/src/catalog/query.py
index bb78bbc..bcc4431 100644
--- a/src/catalog/query.py
+++ b/src/catalog/query.py
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
+import re
+
 from src.shared.formatting import receipt_code
 
 def receipt_for(reference):
@@ -6,3 +8,47 @@ def receipt_for(reference):
 
 def all_product_ids(items):
     return [item["id"] for item in items]
+
+_PRICE_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?")
+LABEL_LENGTH = 8
+
+def _product_error(item):
+    """Return the first invalid field reason for an item, or None."""
+    item_id = item.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(item_id, str) or item_id == "":
+        return "invalid_id"
+    if not isinstance(item.get("name"), str):
+        return "invalid_name"
+    if not isinstance(item.get("active"), bool):
+        return "invalid_active"
+    if not isinstance(item.get("category"), str):
+        return "invalid_category"
+    price = item.get("price")
+    if not isinstance(price, str) or _PRICE_PATTERN.fullmatch(price) is None:
+        return "invalid_price"
+    return None
+
+def _two_decimal_price(price):
+    # String arithmetic only, so the caller's decimal context is never touched.
+    whole, _, fraction = price.partition(".")
+    return (whole.lstrip("0") or "0") + "." + (fraction + "00")[:2]
+
+def product_snapshot(items, category=None):
+    """Validate every item, then list active products matching the category."""
+    products = []
+    errors = []
+    for index, item in enumerate(items):
+        reason = _product_error(item)
+        if reason is not None:
+            errors.append({"index": index, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+        if not item["active"]:
+            continue
+        if category is not None and item["category"] != category:
+            continue
+        products.append({
+            "id": item["id"],
+            "label": item["name"][:LABEL_LENGTH],
+            "price": _two_decimal_price(item["price"]),
+        })
+    return {"products": products, "errors": errors}
